reasoning: This trial enrolled only 2 patients over 10+ months and was terminated early. With n=2 and 0% response rate, this represents a catastrophic failure in enrollment and execution rather than a meaningful test of the therapeutic hypothesis. The combination of cabozantinib (VEGFR/MET/AXL inhibitor) + pembrolizumab (PD-1 inhibitor) has biological rationale for hepatocellular carcinoma, but severe safety signals (necrotizing fasciitis, general weakness) in 50-100% of patients suggest either dose-limiting toxicity or wrong population selection. The extremely small sample size makes it impossible to assess target engagement, pathway modulation, or clinical translation meaningfully.
